stories.title: Security forces kill 74 terrorists during IBOs in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces have killed 74 terrorists during intelligence-based operations (IBOs) in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) and Balochistan, said a statement by the military’s media wing on Friday. President, PM pay tribute to security forces Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif paid tribute to security forces personnel for eliminating terrorists in an intelligence-based operation in Kurram, APP reported.

stories.title: Security forces kill 31 terrorists in Balochistan operation: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed 31 terrorists during intelligence-based operations in Balochistan's Kurram area, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Friday. He also commended the security forces for effectively destroying multiple terrorist hideouts and recovering a large quantity of weapons, ammunition and explosives during the operation, praising their professionalism and courage.

stories.title: Govt extends security guarantees
stories.brief: Political leadership of Pakistan's two mineral rich provinces on Thursday extended security guarantees to foreign investors, as the federal government is also expected to announce new promissory deals with an international mining firm to extract critical minerals.

stories.title: Naqvi meets Zardari in Nawabshah
stories.brief: Federal Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi made an unscheduled visit to Nawabshah on Thursday night and held a nearly hour-long meeting with President Asif Ali Zardari at Zardari House, amid speculation over discussions on key political developments.

stories.title: Punjab, Sindh face severe water shortfall
stories.brief: The Indus River System Authority (IRSA) has approved a 22pc water shortage for the Rabi season, running from October 1, 2026, to March 31, 2027, based on anticipated river inflows of 21.268 million acre-feet.
